details: The Eurosystem has launched Pontes, a new solution enabling wholesale transactions in tokenized assets to be settled using central bank money. This initiative is a crucial step in the Eurosystem's strategy to adapt central bank money for a tokenized financial future, aiming to enhance the integration, innovation, and resilience of the European financial market. The system builds on 2024 tests and seeks to provide a risk-free settlement asset for broader adoption of distributed ledger technology (DLT) in finance.
title: Eurosystem unveils 'Pontes' for tokenized finance using central bank money.

details: Saudi Arabia has officially exited the China-led mBridge digital currency platform after completing its planned proof of concept. The platform aimed to enable cross-border transactions using central bank digital currencies, reducing reliance on the US dollar. Despite Saudi Arabia's departure, African banks are reportedly deepening their integration with China's yuan payment infrastructure.
title: Saudi Arabia withdraws from China-led mBridge digital currency project.

details: Global financial markets, including cryptocurrencies, are exhibiting caution amid mounting geopolitical uncertainty. Tensions in the Middle East, along with diplomatic meetings between leaders like President Trump and Gulf leaders, are impacting oil prices, which in turn affect broader risk sentiment. Bitcoin, while sometimes seen as a safe-haven asset, remains sensitive to these macroeconomic and geopolitical shifts, leading to periods of volatility.
title: Geopolitical tensions and oil price movements influence crypto markets.

details: US prosecutors are reportedly investigating Binance for allegedly allowing Iran-linked entities to trade, potentially violating US sanctions. The US Treasury Secretary stated in April that the US began targeting crypto wallets tied to the Iranian regime, freezing funds primarily in Tether's USDT stablecoin. This follows recent actions by the US Department of Justice to seize and forfeit $61 million in cryptocurrency linked to sanctioned Iranian oil sales laundered through Binance by Chinese entities.
sourceName: Decrypt (as cited by the snippet, though ideally a more mainstream source)
title: US Feds probe Binance over alleged Iranian sanctions evasion via Bitcoin.
